correctness.rationale: For the exact nonovershooting Landweber iterate with one reused isotropic noise vector, diagonalizing A^T A yields sigma^2 omega f_K(omega lambda_i) with f_K(t)=[1-(1-t)^K]^2/t and f_K(0)=0. The derivative sign converts to 2K-sum_{j=0}^{K-1}u^{-j}, giving a unique interior peak for K>=2 (K=1 monotone). For ordered t<=s, unimodality and f_K(1)=1 imply f_K(t)<=M_K f_K(s). Selecting an omitted maximizer and the r retained modes supplies r+1 covariance eigenvalues >= error_B/M_K, so the (r+1)-st eigenvalue gives sharp norm quasi-optimality. The r+1 diagonal witness with r normal eigenvalues one and one t_K gives exact equality. K=1, null normal modes, ties, and optimal-error-zero are handled. The scaling bound f_K(t)/K<=min(Kt,1/(Kt)) and compact uniform limit prove Kt_K->tau_* and M_K/K->(1-e^-tau_*)^2/tau_*, tau_*>0 satisfying e^tau=1+2tau. Independent rational check K=2=32/27, numerical tau coefficient 0.407264377589 and 250 spectral samples at each of six K corroborated the statements; samples alone are not proofs.
